algorithm: Direct interval/calendar overlaps with45-digit Decimal arithmetic; no producer helpers and no per-day price expansion
scientific_limits: Bounds assume source paths capture all changes and at most one effective new price per boundary day; unlisted intraday round-trips are not identified.
Bounds are sensitivity envelopes, not confidence or prediction intervals.
Date-only source chronology does not establish midnight changes.
Month-end values can be available even when earlier days are missing; monthly averages remain blank.
